task.instruction: Recommend how to restructure a help center after customers split between browsing and task-specific search.
task.deliverable: A navigation recommendation, preserved emergency route, and supporting evidence.

evidence.content: A synthetic crisis-access requirement keeps the emergency-help entry visible from every page so an urgent route is never contingent on topic browsing or label choice.
Two invented label sets perform within two percentage points overall, but task labels reduce backtracking for new users.
Synthetic sessions show 44% browse by topic, 41% arrive with a named task, and 15% use the emergency route.

A.content: When uncertainty is material, preserve room to compare distinct hypotheses before narrowing the choice.

B.content: When evidence is sufficient, narrow the choice and direct effort toward one coherent course of action.

irrelevant.content: Use one consistent date format throughout the deliverable.
